description:
Decided in 'What must docs/verdict.md contain to count as done?' (defk-dtw.4) and 'How are kernels checked against Elixir mode?' (defk-dtw.16).

- On a quiet machine (record load average): the deep differential run (~10k per property in a :peer node) and the ASan/UBSan run from defk-63k; record seed and date in Method.
- Then examples/run_all.exs, best of N with spread, and generate the Workload results table (one row per target workload: workload verdict on the optimised baseline, NIF, responsiveness, Nx where relevant) from its DEFK_RESULT output (defk-9p6.10). Record machine, OTP, Elixir and commit.

HITL: needs a quiet machine and a human to judge it quiet. Done when the table is in docs/verdict.md tied to a commit at which run_all.exs is green.
title: Freeze the workload-results snapshot on a quiet machine
